hypothesised_pattern: The residual sign is set by a bilinear x2*x5 interaction: the target is above the prediction when x2 and x5 have the same sign and below it when they differ.
rationale: All five positive residuals (+0.21) have x2*x5 > 0 (about 3.0, 1.05, 4.4, 0.55, 0.90), and all five negative residuals (-0.20 to -0.21) have x2*x5 < 0 (about -1.34, -0.65, -1.0, -0.68, -1.66). Here |x4| overlaps heavily between the groups (0.745 negative vs -0.746 positive), so x4 does not explain these rows, while the product sign separates them perfectly.
